honest.statement: ∀ x0 x1 x2 : Bool, (xor (xor x0 x1) (!x2)) = (xor x0 (xor x1 (!x2)))
∀ x0 x1 x2 x3 : Bool, (xor x0 (xor (xor x1 x2) (!x3))) = (xor (xor x0 (xor x1 x2)) (!x3))
∀ x0 x1 x2 : Bool, (xor x0 (xor x1 x2)) = (xor (xor x0 x1) x2)
∀ x0 x1 x2 : Bool, ((xor x0 x1) && x2) = (x2 && (xor x0 x1))

leaky_control.statement: ∀ x0 x1 : Bool, (x0 && (xor x0 x1)) = (xor x0 (x0 && x1))
∀ x0 x1 x2 : Bool, (xor (!x0) (xor x1 x2)) = (!(xor x0 (xor x1 x2)))
∀ x0 x1 : Bool, (xor x0 (x0 && x1)) = (x0 && (xor x0 x1))
∀ x0 x1 : Bool, (xor (!x0) x1) = (!(xor x0 x1))
